answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks by discounting correlated behavior: when many identities vote, trade, or attest in perfect lockstep, the system treats them as one voice echoed like a sonnet repeated word for word, not as many independent minds, and scales down their combined weight. An attacker must then build a bridge of distinct, costly behavior for each fake identity instead of cloning one cheap pattern. Honest agents, whose actions diverge naturally, keep full weight, so real influence flows like nectar only to genuine diversity, never to mass-produced copies.
